column1: # Step 1's five finished repos, and the opaque name each is copied to before a grader sees it.
# `mastra-head1` beside `mastra-control2` tells a grader which side is which from the path alone,
# so the token is what gets attached. The mapping is not secret — it is just never in the call.
# control2b is a second, byte-identical copy of control2 under a different token. It exists so
# a pair can show the grader the same change on both sides: if that does not come out Yes/Yes,
# the grader cannot say "these are equivalent" and every preference it reports is manufactured.
